title: Block CSS
description: The value contract for a block's optional `customCss` (ADR-0026). The field's label, help text and css-editor extension all live here, shared by every block, so a block's property is just a reference.

css.title: Custom CSS (advanced)
css.description: Optional. CSS for this block only — it also reaches any blocks nested inside it. Bare declarations style the block itself (background: …); nested rules style what's inside (h2 { … }, &:hover { … }, @media … { … }); custom properties (--color-primary: …) flow down to child blocks. Leave blank for none.
